/* ==========================================================================
   Resonance workspace — near-black surfaces, lime accent, violet node hues.
   Three-column grid around the existing graph renderer; the graph itself
   keeps its own palette (scene/palette.ts) and overlays stay fixed-position.
   ========================================================================== */
:root {
  --rs-bg: #0b0b11;
  --rs-panel: #0e0e15;
  --rs-raised: #15151e;

  --rs-line-strong: #2c2c3a;
  --rs-text: #f1f0f6;
  --rs-muted: #9a99a8;
  /* Faint text still clears 4.5:1 on the panel surfaces (≈5.6:1 on #0b0b11). */
  --rs-faint: #8a8998;
  /* Disabled text clears 4.5:1 on the raised surface (#15151e) as well. */
  --rs-disabled: #7f7e8c;
  --rs-lime: #c8f55a;
  --rs-lime-ink: #10140a;
  --rs-violet: #a89bff;
  --rs-top: 76px;
  --rs-left: 266px;
  --rs-brand: 266px;
  --rs-right: 372px;
  --bg-void: var(--rs-bg);
}
